verdict.rationale: Morph publishes specific vendor throughput numbers (Fast Apply 10,500+ tok/s at 98% accuracy, Compact at 33,000 tok/s, classifiers at ~90ms, GitHub demo citing 4,500+ tok/s) across multiple docs pages, which is more concrete than typical marketing copy. However, there's no published benchmark methodology, no independent load-testing guide, and no third-party benchmark reproducing these numbers — community comments are anecdotal praise/complaints about apply quality rather than speed verification. Missing for 10: an independent/third-party benchmark or reproducible load-testing methodology, and a dedicated benchmarks page with test conditions.
